details:
Cosmic Health Monitor

Cosmic Health Monitor is an interactive, AI-assisted health-monitoring dashboard designed to help astronauts track, assess, and understand changes in their physical and mental health during long-duration space missions.

The application allows astronauts to complete daily health check-ins by selecting relevant symptoms, identifying affected body areas, and indicating symptom severity on a scale of 1 to 5. Based on their responses, the system generates a daily health analysis, identifies potential health concerns, and provides relevant precautions and recommendations to help astronauts manage their well-being.

The platform covers multiple health categories, including musculoskeletal, cardiovascular, immune, respiratory, mental and behavioral health, sleep, and other symptoms. It also provides access to a built-in AI assistant that astronauts can use to ask health-related questions and receive additional guidance.

Users can review their previous health check-ins and monitor changes in their symptoms over time through health history and visual analytics. This allows them to recognize recurring symptoms and better understand potential changes in their health throughout a mission.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to unique health challenges, including microgravity-related physical changes, sleep disruption, psychological stress, and other physiological risks. Continuous health monitoring is therefore essential to maintaining astronaut well-being and supporting mission success.

Cosmic Health Monitor aims to:

  • Encourage consistent health monitoring through daily check-ins.
  • Help astronauts recognize and track potential health concerns.
  • Provide accessible health information and preventive recommendations.
  • Support early awareness of changes in physical and mental well-being.
  • Maintain a historical record of health observations throughout a mission.
  • Make health information more accessible through an integrated AI assistant.

The intended impact is to support proactive health management, help astronauts make more informed decisions about their well-being, and contribute to safer, more sustainable long-duration space exploration.

Technologies and Tools

The application was developed using web technologies:

  • HTML5: Structure and organization of the application.
  • CSS3: Interface design, responsive layouts, and visual styling.
  • JavaScript: Application logic, interactive check-in workflows, symptom tracking, health analysis, and data management.
  • LocalStorage: Saving user profiles, health check-ins, and historical health records locally.
  • Charting and data visualization: Presenting health trends and historical observations.

Creativity and Innovation

Cosmic Health Monitor combines daily symptom tracking, health analysis, historical monitoring, and conversational AI assistance into a single interactive platform.

Rather than simply displaying health information, the application creates a structured process through which astronauts can regularly report symptoms, assess their severity, receive relevant guidance, and review their health history.

Its combination of an interactive body-area selection interface, categorized symptom assessment, severity scoring, personalized feedback, and an integrated assistant makes health monitoring more accessible and engaging.

Factors Considered During Development

Several factors influenced the design and development of Cosmic Health Monitor:

  • Mission environment: Astronauts may have limited access to immediate medical assistance during long-duration missions.
  • Health diversity: The platform considers several aspects of astronaut health rather than focusing exclusively on physical symptoms.
  • Usability: The check-in process is organized into simple, interactive steps.
  • Continuity: Health records are maintained so users can review previous observations and identify changes over time.
  • Accessibility: The built-in assistant provides an additional way to access health-related information.
  • Preventive approach: The platform emphasizes early awareness, monitoring, and precautions rather than waiting for health concerns to become more serious.

Cosmic Health Monitor is an educational prototype and is not an official NASA medical system, a diagnostic tool, or a replacement for professional medical evaluation.
